library(tidyverse)
library(tinytable)
rates <- read_csv("unemployment.csv")
REGION <- "Asir"
area    <- rates |> filter(region == REGION)
kingdom <- rates |> filter(region == "Kingdom")
now  <- last(area$rate)
then <- first(area$rate)
gap  <- now - last(kingdom$rate)
